subject: Algorithm32 Paper J4 experimental Lebedev-38 candidate

mismatches.disposition: The candidate stops after cumulative J1 + J2 + J3 + J4 rather than resolving libRadtran DISORT's fuller multiple-scattering solution.
The candidate uses a 38-node antipodally closed ninth-degree Lebedev incoming quadrature and the separate W27 source-aligned outgoing reconstruction; retained libRadtran DISORT uses 16 streams.

The candidate retains 48 physical altitude nodes, 40 view-path and higher-order transport intervals, and 20 source-transmittance intervals; libRadtran uses its retained layered atmosphere and solver controls.
The candidate uses exact ray intersections with its spherical atmosphere; the retained libRadtran setup is pseudospherical.
